skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Young Branch
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Young Branch. Water melts glacier on its way back to the soil, while wandering leaves revisit the woods. Her origins in eternal sleep, her answers long departed. But where are they now?
skins.usage: One of Muelsyse's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'But It has still left some memories behind for us. Are they mementos, or lamentations? I don't know...'

skins.name: Golden Reverie
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Golden Reverie. Dress carefully picked by Muelsyse. The top is bright and brazen, like the early dawnlight, and the skirt is soft and sable, like the moons playing across a still lake—a perfect union of luxury and solemnity.
skins.quote: It is as if time stands still here. A golden hall, a golden dream—and in the time it takes you to think this, an elf walks out from under the archway, gracing you with a smile. At that instant, time resumes its flow.
